description: Department of Fiscal Policy  -  Excise Duty on Foreign Liquor w.e.f.  03.12.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the establishment of new excise duties and import regulations for foreign liquor under the Excise Ordinance. It creates regulatory requirements, specifies duty rates, and outlines compliance procedures - all characteristic of legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory function being exercised.
